in_arabic.name: خُلَائِدَة
in_arabic.meaning: أَرَضَاءَ الْقَلَمِ وَخُلُودُ المَعاشِقِ وَخُلُوَّةُ الْحِجَامِ وَخُلُودُ المَطَرِ

In modern times, the name Khulaidah has gained popularity in many Muslim countries, including Turkey, Egypt, and Indonesia.
